vibe.verdict: Right place and right voice, but the poster sits in a box with big black bars and the menu skips the Rat Trap and the clock tower.
missing: The Rat Trap tavern (Basil and Dawson in disguise)
Ratigan's Rube Goldberg death trap (Ratigan's lair)
The Big Ben clock tower finale
Toby the basset hound on the scent trail
Basil firing a gun at the pillows (Mrs Judson's house)
ideas: Replace the boxed poster with a full-bleed Baker Street image so the black bars go.
Swap 'Scotch eggs' for 'Rat Trap pub pie' with the sailors' disguise story.
Swap the 'Flaversham's toy shop gingerbread' note for 'Gingerbread soldiers, minus their uniforms' (Fidget's thefts).
Replace 'Victoria sponge' note with 'Queen Moustoria's Diamond Jubilee cake'.
iconic: There's always a chance, Doctor, as long as one can think
Ratigan, slimy contemptible sewer rat (no slot)
Big Ben finale (wink only, not printed)
changed: Signed note is Basil's real line
Roast note is the Queen's Jubilees line
Scotch eggs renamed Rat Trap Scotch eggs
